title: Engineered multi-domain lipid nanoparticles for targeted delivery
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00891J, Review Article
Zhaoyu Liu, Jingxun Chen, Mingkun Xu, Sherwin Ho, Yuanyuan Wei, Ho-Pui Ho, Ken-Tye Yong
This review introduces a four-domain framework to dissect engineered lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) rationally and explores their programmability, in vivo behavior, and emerging AI-driven strategies for design, simulation, and clinical translation.
